## Sales Team Architecture

Building a sales team is both an art and a science. The best sales organizations combine the right people, processes, and tools into a predictable revenue engine.

### Sales Org Design by Stage

| Company Stage | ARR | Sales Team Structure |
|---|---|---|
| Founder-led | $0-$1M | Founders selling, 0-1 AE |
| Early sales | $1-$5M | 2-4 AEs, 1 SDR per AE |
| Growth | $5-$20M | VP Sales, team leads, 8-15 AEs, SDR team |
| Scale | $20-$100M | CRO, directors, specialized teams, sales ops |
| Enterprise | $100M+ | Global org, regional leaders, enterprise and commercial segments |

### Compensation by Role

| Role | Base | Variable | Total OTE | Quota Multiple |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| SDR/BDR | $45K-$60K | $20K-$35K | $65K-$95K | N/A (meetings) |
| SMB AE | $55K-$75K | $55K-$75K | $110K-$150K | 4-5x OTE |
| Mid-Market AE | $75K-$100K | $75K-$100K | $150K-$200K | 4-5x OTE |
| Enterprise AE | $100K-$140K | $100K-$150K | $200K-$290K | 3-4x OTE |
| Sales Manager | $100K-$130K | $50K-$80K | $150K-$210K | Team quota |
| Director | $130K-$170K | $60K-$100K | $190K-$270K | Region quota |
| VP Sales | $160K-$220K | $80K-$150K | $240K-$370K | Org quota |

### The Sales Hiring Assessment

#### Discovery Call Simulation (30 min)

Role-play a prospect meeting. Evaluate:

- Question quality and sequencing
- Active listening and note-taking
- Ability to uncover pain and quantify impact
- Poise and professionalism

#### Presentation/Demo (30 min)

Have them present a product they know well. Evaluate:

- Storytelling ability
- Handling of objections
- Ability to connect features to business value
- Closing technique

#### Pipeline Review (30 min)

Walk through their current or recent pipeline. Evaluate:

- Pipeline management rigor
- Deal qualification methodology (BANT, MEDDPICC)
- Forecasting accuracy
- Strategic account planning

#### References

Sales references are critical:

- Talk to former managers about consistency, not just peak performance
- Ask about quota attainment over multiple quarters
- Understand the market conditions and territory they operated in

### Predictors of Sales Success

| Factor | Predictive Power | How to Assess |
|---|---|---|
| Coachability | Very High | Give feedback during the interview; do they adapt? |
| Curiosity | Very High | Quality of questions asked during discovery role-play |
| Work ethic | High | Activity metrics from previous roles |
| Intelligence | High | Ability to understand complex business problems |
| Prior success | Medium | Quota attainment (adjust for territory/market) |
| Industry experience | Low-Medium | Teachable; prioritize selling ability |

### Ramp Time by Role

| Role | Expected Ramp | Full Productivity |
|---|---|---|
| SDR | 1-2 months | Month 3 |
| SMB AE | 2-3 months | Month 4-5 |
| Mid-Market AE | 3-4 months | Month 5-6 |
| Enterprise AE | 4-6 months | Month 7-9 |
